response.original_title: Dutroux: het trauma van een land
response.overview: A disappearance in the summer of 1996 evolves into a national trauma. Following the arrest of Marc Dutroux, a gruesome truth comes to light. The case shakes confidence in the justice system and changes society forever.
response.tagline: "Exactly thirty years ago, a missing persons case turned into the darkest chapter in Belgian history. What followed was a national tragedy that changed our country forever”
response.title: Dutroux: het trauma van een land
